findings.title: AI/Agent Framework RCE Mega-Cluster — 17 CVEs in One Disclosure Wave, and the Same Three Design Failures in Every One
findings.summary_md: ThreatAft published a consolidated analysis of 17 CVEs across 12 AI agent and LLM orchestration products disclosed on October 19-20, 2026. Six carry CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated remote code execution in Piflow, Langchain-Chatchat, DB-GPT, Letta, and Cognition, and five more at CVSS 8.8 require only an account. The article attributes the cluster to three recurring design failures: authentication defaulting to off, unsandboxed tool execution, and approval gates that fail open or are absent.

findings.title: CVE-2026-77932: Missing Authentication for Critical Function in eosphoros-ai DB-GPT
findings.summary_md: The Threat Radar advisory records CVE-2026-77932 in DB-GPT through 0.8.2, where the /api/v1/chat/react-agent endpoint relies on a mock get_user_from_headers function that grants every caller the admin role. Unauthenticated attackers can run arbitrary Python or bash through the ReAct agent's unsandboxed code_interpreter and shell_interpreter tools. The advisory also notes DB-GPT's bundled database uses default credentials, compounding the exposure.

findings.title: CVE-2026-77932: DB-GPT through 0.8.2 Unauthenticated RCE via /api/v1/chat/react-agent
findings.summary_md: VulnCheck published an advisory for CVE-2026-77932 crediting Noy Pearl, Michael Sromin, and Ophir Dror as finders. DB-GPT through 0.8.2 exposes an unauthenticated remote code execution path through the react-agent endpoint, which grants every caller the admin role and runs unsandboxed code and shell tools as root. The advisory references the Lasso Security vulnerability database and the affected DB-GPT source files.

findings.title: CVE-2026-77932: DB-GPT through 0.8.2 Unauthenticated RCE via /api/v1/chat/react-agent
findings.summary_md: Strix AI lists CVE-2026-77932 as a critical 9.8 vulnerability in DB-GPT through 0.8.2. The flaw is an unauthenticated remote code execution issue in which the react-agent endpoint trusts a mock authentication header that assigns the admin role to all callers. Attackers can invoke unsandboxed interpreter tools and reach the bundled database.
